explication: Maka is a local-first agent workspace. A user starts a task in Desktop or the CLI; the Runtime Host coordinates sessions and AgentRuns, which invoke models and tools. Runtime Events form the durable record of messages, tool calls, approvals, and termination, from which UI and recovery projections are derived. The map also shows documented workspaces, plugins, computer use, evaluation, peer connectivity, and local storage. Some backend implementations are unsampled, so those links follow README architecture rather than inferred sibling imports.
